text:
alex: Following the DR postmortem, scheduling a focused game-day rehearsal. Goal: validate routing convergence, exercise partial & restore timelines, confirm backups across providers, and capture any recurring failure patterns. Who can own the action tracker?

maria: I'll own backup validation across S3/GCS and the cross-check against manifest. Will also audit retention / lifecycle rules to ensure we have 30d of rolling snapshots.

jonah: I'll do the partial restore and smoke tests in `dr-sandbox`. Plan: metadata-only first, then a targeted table restore if time permits. Will instrument timestamps for each step to update the runbook timings.

emily: I'll take runbook updates and the play-by-play template. Need to add explicit rollback gates and a quick checklist for external consumers.

sandeep: I'll own routing policies and synthetic traffic scripts. I'll test reroute, sticky sessions, and KV cache warmup. Also will profile leader-lease expiry behavior.

tara: I'll consolidate follow-up tickets and owners in JIRA, and will schedule a 1-week retrospective on recurring patterns.

alex: Proposed short action list (please ack):
- 1) Backup verification + retention audit -> maria -> due: Thu EOD
- 2) Partial restore timeline + smoke tests -> jonah -> due: Fri 10:00 PT
- 3) Routing canary + KV warmup profile -> sandeep -> due: Thu EOD
- 4) Runbook timing + rollback gates -> emily -> due: Fri 09:00 PT
- 5) Collate tickets for follow-ups -> tara -> due: Mon 12:00 PT

maria: backup checklist (copying commands):
- list snapshots: `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-backups/ --recursive --human-readable`
- verify one manifest: `gsutil cat gs://redwood-backups/manifests/2026-05-02.json | jq .parts`
- checksum sample: `sha256sum s3://redwood-backups/2026-05-02/full.tar.gz`
I'll post hashes & manifest diffs here.

jonah: restore commands I'll run in sandbox:
```
pg_restore --schema=public --table=metadata -d dr_meta_test /snapshots/2026-05-02/meta.dump
kubectl -n dr-sandbox rollout restart deploy/api
```
I'll time db restore, migration, and smoke test phases separately.

sandeep: routing policy I'll exercise (staging snippet):
```
traffic_policy:
  primary: us-west1
  secondaries: [eu-west1, us-central1]
  failover_grace: 45s
  kv_cache_ttl: 120s
```
I'll run a phased failover and collect histograms for connection resets and cache misses.

emily: runbook additions: add explicit timeouts for each step, rehearse points where automatic rollback must kick in, and add a short incident capture template: symptom, step_timestamps, metric snapshot, logs excerpt, mitigation, follow-up ticket.

alex: Recurring patterns to watch (from recent incidents):
- slow-ish routing convergence tied to stale routing table entries
- prolonged KV warmup causing elevated latency for ~2-3 minutes
- leader lease drift when control-plane clocks skew ~>30s
Tag any observations `#game-day` and `#pattern` so tara can map frequencies.

tara: Note: I'll create JIRA epic RF-DR-2026 and link tickets with labels `dr-rehearsal` and `recurring-pattern`. Please include short repro or logs in the ticket.

ops-bot: Calendar event created -> 2026-05-05T16:00:00Z (Warm-standby DR rehearsal). Channel posted: #incidents/dr-rehearsal-1801234567. Oncall rota will be notified 45m prior.

sandeep: Quick status: ran staging canary this morning, observed KV miss spike ~2200ms on first requests, dropped to baseline after 90s. Captured traces: link to perf-dashboard (internal). Will open ticket with trace id.

maria: Backup integrity: found one anomaly in GCS manifest mismatch for 2026-04-28 (missing chunk-42). Re-running object inventory now, will escalate if not found.

jonah: Partial restore in sandbox complete. Timings: DB restore 24m, migrs 4m, app boot + smoke 12m => total 40m. All smoke checks passed (tokenization, health endpoints, small generate).

emily: Updated runbook with measured timings and added rollback gates at: pre-shift snapshot, 15m KV warmup check, and 30m human-confirmation before full traffic shift. Pushed to repo and linked in channel.

tara: Tickets created: DR-101 (missing backup chunk) -> owner: maria; DR-102 (kv-warmup perf) -> owner: sandeep; DR-103 (runbook clarifications) -> owner: emily. I'll collect owners and due dates in the epic.

alex: Thanks. Final ask: each owner post a 1-2 sentence status here when their item is triaged/complete. We'll run the live rehearsal on Wed and collect incidents in the new channel.

sched-bot: Reminder scheduled: ping channel 45m before rehearsal.

maria: Will update thread after inventory completes.

sandeep: I'll attach load script and perf snapshots to DR-102.

emily: I'll run the play-by-play during the rehearsal and capture timestamps.

alex: Great work. Closing the planning thread, will see you in the rehearsal channel. :rocket:
